headline: Vietnam raises $82 million in weekly government bond auction amid lower uptake
summary: Vietnam's State Treasury raised 2.1 trillion dong ($82 million) at its weekly bond auction, down from $234 million the previous week, with auction uptake falling to 28% from 80%.
why: Primary bond auction uptake in Vietnam reflects banking system liquidity, yields, and institutional appetite for government debt.

impacts.name: Vietnam Government Bond Yield
impacts.why: A decline in auction uptake to 28% signals reduced local bank demand for sovereign paper.
